title: Augment audit preview
summary: Every top-quality augment and its zone, plus the unreleased secondary-stat and icon candidate.
body:
Not released: this November 6 audit candidate changes augment eligibility, secondary bonuses and icons. Current live catalog values remain below their normal pages. No deployment or player acceptance is claimed.

Drops and progression

The candidate uses a 1.5% augment roll on any unowned, killable NPC in an enabled reward zone, including guards, named/quest enemies, killable merchants and scripted combat adds. Player-owned pets, mercenaries, restored corpses and protected noncombat actors do not qualify. Corpse ownership and encounter access still apply. The existing equipment allowlist is separate.

Base / Polished / Exalted / Ascension weights remain 60% / 30% / 8% / 2%. That is about one augment per 67 kills, or one direct Ascension per 3,333 kills on average; forging offers the other route. Random drops have no guarantee. Chapterhouse and the Ashen Compact move from 0.5% to 1.5% within their managed expeditions. The candidate enables the already accessible Classic Cazic-Thule and newer Hate layout pools. The six other disabled pools remain disabled.

Secondary bonuses

Existing primary stats, heroics, required levels and six type-22 armor socket locations remain. Specialty budgets at Ascension are Avoidance +4, Accuracy +5, Shielding +1%, Spell Shielding +2%, Spell Damage or Healing Amount up to +8 per augment (existing higher values retained). Six identical copies therefore add at most 24 Avoidance, 30 Accuracy, 6% Shielding, 12% Spell Shielding or 48 raw damage/healing. Existing item caps, other equipment, AAs and buffs still matter.

Shield block is distinct from Shielding: designated families add +1% at Polished/Exalted or +2% at Ascension, with only the strongest Hunt shield-block augment counted. A usable shield is required. Dodge families use Improved Dodge I from Exalted onward; the strongest worn dodge effect applies, rather than adding six copies. Spell haste and mana preservation unlock minor stock focus at Polished and full Spell Haste III / Mana Preservation III at Ascension. Stock limits and strongest-focus behavior apply: haste is 15% at the top with a three-second minimum cast, mana preservation rolls 1–10%, and both use the stock level-60 limit. Four utility families gain Faerune at Ascension (breathing, vision and see invisibility).

Recognizable drops

All four qualities in a family use a stock gem, crystal or orb icon. The old cloth gloves and default necklace are replaced. No client artwork download is needed; visible loot and inspection checks remain part of release QA.

Ascension is the actual in-game top-quality name; “Ascended augments” refers to these items.

Release checks

Guard drops, scripted adds, expedition corpse recovery, shield/dodge/focus stacking, full loot bags, forging and visible icons require in-game QA before acceptance. Existing live Hunt and encounter balance acceptance remains separate.

Classic raid augments are in development. The level-50 trophies compete for one chest socket.
